title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): Working Translation and Source-Audit Drafts
description:
Public SGA working-translation and source-audit record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page preserves SGA reader PDFs, French/reference witnesses, source-scan slices, repair/source ZIPs, and audit-support bundles for continuation and correction.

Status at a glance. This is serious source-aware working material, not OCR-only, but it is not a globally certified complete SGA edition and not a critical edition. SGA5 has real page-local French repair/audit work and substantial TeX/PDF working surfaces; SGA6 and SGA7 have substantial translation/source-audit material. All branches retain explicit source-check, compression, synchronization, and diagram/formula caveats.

SGA5 caveat. SGA5 is not complete, independently certified, English-synchronized, or globally source-faithful. Later workpass labels such as certified, clean, complete, strict, or high-fidelity should be read as page-local ledger language only unless a specific later packet explicitly promotes an exact locus after source comparison. Older global SGA5 drafts still contain diagram, prose, symbol, functor-level, and cross-reference errors outside audited loci.

Local SGA5 live-ledger update, 2026-07-02. The latest compact promoted SGA5 delta remains SGA5_FullAudit_WebDrop_p260_p265_workpass_delta_20260626.zip, which promotes only p260-p265 as page-local French workpass/source-audit evidence. Later local workpass/provenance evidence under SGA continuation 2/_claude_aid/sga5_full_audit_20260623 now reaches the forward cursor p397 in CERT_LOG.md. Exposé VIII is closed at p371. Exposé X has been checked through the Euler-Poincaré formula (7.2) and proof steps a/b: p392 verifies triangle diagram D179, p393 completes the proof of Proposition 5.1 / the Weil formula, p394-p395 fix the systematic A vs Λ transcription error in Hom/Sw terms, p396 completes the §6 examples and states Theorem 7.1, and p397 fixes a dropped prime C to C'. Fixes #35-#44 are recorded; diagrams are tracked through D179; p398 is queued for RHom / A-vs-Λ checks. The p266-p397 evidence is live ledger/provenance only unless later compactly packaged and promoted. It is not a compact promoted delta, not a reader release, not SGA5 completion, not English synchronization, not global source-faithfulness certification, and not a critical edition. CERT_LOG.md currently has an older p125 row physically appended after p397, so p397 is the public forward cursor rather than the final physical line.

SGA6 and SGA7 caveat. SGA6 and SGA7 are substantial working translation/reconstruction surfaces, but they retain known compression and source-detail risks. Treat them as mathematically useful working drafts and repair targets, not as final transcriptions.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, Source-Checked, or High-Fidelity are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves. A compile-clean PDF can still contain real source/math errors.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
